field_text_formatted.value: Browsers won't send that cookie to a frontend on another domain, such as example.vercel.app, so the preview reads with a token instead. Install Simple OAuth, then on the consumer's form turn on the Authorization Code grant, and give its Authorization Code settings a scope for a role made for previews, rather than your editors' own. A scope under Default scopes alone gets the preview a 403.
